title: TactiNavi: Serving and Revising an LLM Game Coach with Explicit Strategy Conditions
title_zh: TactiNavi：以显式策略条件服务与修订LLM游戏教练

paragraphs.en: TactiNavi是商业游戏LLM教练服务系统，通过显式策略条件包与发布验证将正确率从57.9%提升至82.0%。 A deployed LLM coaching agent answers requests whose correct response depends on player state and game version, so advice that is right for one player can be wrong for the next. We describe TactiNavi, the serving system behind the LLM coach of a commercial open-world game, which makes strategy applicability an explicit artifact shared by offline compilation, online execution, failure diagnosis, and release. An offline compiler turns versioned game evidence and expert guidance into strategy packages with explicit prerequisites, the serving plane evaluates those prerequisites as three-valued conditions over structured player state and records decision traces, and a control plane uses the resulting condition-rule dependencies to validate revisions on held-out traffic before release. In a retrospective evaluation of 1,122 logged coaching turns from three deployment periods, condition-bearing packages raise correctness from 57.9% to 82.0% over atomic facts and reduce strategy misapplication under changed player state from 18.1% to 10.4%, while trace-based claim verification reaches 86.4% precision at a median reply latency of 2.07 s. The deployment also showed that most apparent fixes are generation noise, because an unchanged-system rerun recovers 38.4% of failing turns and only one of 15 shipped revision units passes the release checks retrospectively. We distill these results into lessons on treating applicability as a first-class serving object, sizing traces for later diagnosis, and building the null model into the release path.
paragraphs.zh: TactiNavi是一个商业游戏LLM教练服务系统，通过显式策略条件包与发布验证将正确率从57.9%提升至82.0%。一个已部署的LLM教练智能体所回答的请求，其正确响应取决于玩家状态和游戏版本，因此对某位玩家正确的建议对下一位玩家可能就是错误的。 我们介绍TactiNavi，这是一个商业开放世界游戏LLM教练背后的服务系统，它将策略适用性变为一个由离线编译、在线执行、故障诊断和发布共享的显式产物。 离线编译器将带版本的游戏证据与专家指导转化为带有显式前提条件的策略包；服务平面将那些前提条件作为基于结构化玩家状态的三值条件进行评估并记录决策轨迹；控制平面则利用由此产生的条件-规则依赖，在发布前对留存流量上的修订版本进行验证。 在对来自三个部署周期的1,122条已记录教练对话轮次的回顾性评估中，带条件的策略包相比原子事实将正确率从57.9%提升至82.0%，并在玩家状态发生变化时将策略误用率从18.1%降至10.4%，同时基于轨迹的主张验证达到86.4%的精确率，中位回复延迟为2.07秒。 部署还表明，大多数看似的修复其实是生成噪声，因为在系统未作改动的重跑中有38.4%的失败轮次得以恢复，且15个已上线的修订单元中只有一个在回顾性检验中通过发布检查。 我们将这些结果提炼为以下经验：将适用性作为一等服务对象、为后续诊断而充分记录轨迹规模，以及将零模型构建进发布路径之中。
